sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 25033 of 2023
Applicant :- Suraj Baranwal And 4 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Balbir Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ajeet Kumar Baranwal,Dibya Baranwal Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 24.04.2023 along with entire criminal proceeding of Case No. 376 of 2023 as well as summoning order dated 10.0.2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 110 of 2022 under Sections 498A,
323, 324, 316, 504 and 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahil Thana, District Basti.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicants that the applicant no. 1, the husband of the opposite party no. 2, has been bailed out.
Hence, some direction be issued to the court concerned regarding bail with respect to the rest of the applicants as they want to surrender before the trial court.

The application is, therefore, disposed of with the direction to the trial court that if the applicant Suraj Baranwal And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54971365/
1 nos. 2 to 5 appear before the trial court within 15 days from today and move an application before the trial court, the same shall be disposed of as soon as possible in view of law laid down in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2021) 10 SCC 773.
